summary: Join our Fair Housing Laws and Compliance Training Course to stay informed and compliant. Equip yourself with essential knowledge for legal adherence.
lede: Fair housing compliance training helps property managers, real estate professionals, and housing program staff make and document fair decisions. It covers recognizing protected classes and discriminatory practices, reviewing advertising and tenant-screening processes, and responding to accommodation requests and complaints. Participants also practice applying policies and documenting decisions in scenarios involving housing operations and program eligibility.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly make, influence, or oversee housing-related decisions where fair housing compliance is essential.
modules: Protected Classes and Types of Discrimination
Tenant Screening, Applications, and Occupancy Standards
Fair Housing in Public and NGO Housing Programs
Communicating, Leading, and Sustaining a Culture of Compliance
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of housing operations and a willingness to engage in interactive discussions and exercises.
